title: Vibe Coding Is Making Indian Developers Unemployable

script.hook: Bhai, tu code likh raha hai ya sirf ChatGPT ka copy-paste machine ban gaya hai?
script.body: Ek survey mein aaya — 67% Indian developers jo sirf AI tools pe depend karte hain, unhe basic DSA problems solve nahi hoti bina AI ke. Vibe coding matlab hai vibes se code karna — bina samjhe, bina sooche. Interviews mein yahi hota hai — recruiter ne ek simple pointer question pucha, aur banda blank ho gaya kyunki pehle toh GPT answer deta tha. Top companies like Google, Microsoft, aur homegrown startups bhi ab specifically puch rahe hain — 'explain karo yeh code kyun kaam karta hai' — aur vibe coders yahan fail ho rahe hain. AI ek tool hai, crutch nahi — jo developer fundamentals jaanta hai, wahi AI ko 10x effectively use kar sakta hai.
script.cta: Comment karo — 'FUNDAMENTALS' agar tu actually samajhke code karta hai, ya 'VIBES' agar tu directly GPT pe jaata hai. Follow karo CodeOrCap — kyunki yahan hum sirf vibes nahi, knowledge dete hain.

metadata.title: Vibe Coding Is Making Indian Developers Unemployable
metadata.description:
Bhai, tu code likh raha hai ya sirf ChatGPT ka copy-paste machine ban gaya hai? Vibe coding sounds cool — but it's quietly destroying the fundamentals of Indian developers. From juniors who can't explain their own code to interviews where AI-generated answers fall flat — the damage is real and recruiters are noticing.

In this video, we break down exactly why vibe coding is a dangerous shortcut, what Indian tech companies are actually seeing in 2025 interviews, and how to use AI tools the right way without losing your core skills.

Whether you're a fresher or a mid-level dev, this is the reality check you need before your next interview or layoff. Don't let AI tools turn you into a copy-paste engineer with zero market value. Learn to think first — then let AI help you build faster.
